about.metaTitle: About the project and site plan
about.title: AI Radar: goal, audience, structure
about.lead: A small working product on top of the public FreeSerp API (index=sites, AI niche). Its job is to quickly find, filter and compare new AI products.
goal: Provide a handy showcase of new AI products: what appeared, in which niche, how authoritative the domain is.
Shorten the “find → evaluate → compare → save” path to a few clicks.
Show how a raw API becomes a product: filters in the URL, caching, account-based favorites, two languages and themes.

audience.name: Founders & PMs
audience.need: competitor research in their niche, idea discovery

audience.name: Marketers & SEO
audience.need: new market players, DR, what sites are built with

audience.name: Investors & scouts
audience.need: early signals: fresh launches by niche

audience.name: Developers
audience.need: which stacks and AI builders are actually used

pages.name: Home
pages.text: Positioning, search, index stats, latest launches, top niches, “built with”, DR leaders.

pages.name: Catalog
pages.text: Search + filters (niche, stack, min DR, date range, sorting), pagination. All filters live in the URL — shareable by link.

pages.name: Niches
pages.text: All categories with product counts and shares. A niche page: metrics, a chart of new sites per day, what the niche is built with, DR leaders, latest launches.

pages.name: Site profile
pages.text: AI summary, facts (DR, dates, stack, server), niches, similar sites from the same niche, “Favorite” and “Compare” buttons.

pages.name: Compare
pages.text: Up to 3 sites in a table, best values highlighted, state in the URL (?d=a.com,b.ai).

structure: Next.js 16 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4, /uk and /en routes (next-intl).
All FreeSerp requests run on the server (Server Components / Route Handler) and are cached for 10 minutes — fast and gentle on the free API.
Favorites — the ai_radar_favorites table in Supabase with Row Level Security: users only see their own rows. Compare works without an account, in localStorage.
Dark (default) and light themes with no flash on load.

api.text: genuine AI products only (filters out noise)
full-text search and exact domain lookup
“built with” filter and the stack chart
index stats and top niches on the home page

caveats: went_live is when FreeSerp first saw the site live, not the official launch; the AI startup set was collected roughly since August 2026.
The ai_categories filter accepts one niche at a time, so the UI offers a single choice.
Site summaries (ai_summary) are generated by FreeSerp in English and are not translated.
